title: DUBOIS vs WARDLEY II — What changes in the rematch?
editorialAngle: Wardley dropped Dubois twice but could not control the later rounds. What changes?
narrationScript: Wardley put Dubois down twice in their first fight. But Dubois recovered and stopped him in round eleven. For the rematch, the question isn't whether Wardley can hurt him. It's whether he can manage the distance and pace when Dubois starts applying pressure. Watch the exits after Wardley attacks, and whether Dubois gets his jab working early. That's where this heavyweight title fight could be decided. What's your pick?
